description: Accompanying data for publication: "Learning the Optimal Power Flow: Environment Design Matters is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Thomas Wolgast, Astrid Nieße (Oldenburger Forschungs- und Entwicklungsinstitut für Informatik eV). All the data created for the publication "Learning the Optimal Power Flow: Environment Design Matters" by Wolgast and Nieße. The dataset contains all training runs performed, including the final neural network weights, meta-data about the training run, and various metrics during the course of training, which were used to generate the results and plots. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
